append.detail: Built 2026-11-16, dark behind HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED (release, import) and HUNTS_ENABLED (reads); decision in ADR-1972. Existing runs keep their rules: migration 20270346072000_hunt_teams_editions.sql (not applied, shared with FH-043) adds a trigger that refuses to move a run to another version or Hunt and a trigger that freezes a published edition (hash, number, trail; forward to superseded only); releaseEdition in lib/hunts/edition-store.ts writes no run, credit or claim, and loadRunRecord reads a run against the version it started on. Printed URLs resolve as intended: the Hunt keeps its slug, and the release records a crosswalk (outgoing stop to the stop at the same place, because stop keys follow position) and carries each mission-to-placement binding across it, so a sign follows its place through a reorder and a sign whose place was dropped is retired and credits nothing. Imports carry no real credits: importRegularsHunt and importQrCampaign in lib/hunts/editions.ts read a legacy hunt's title and places into an unpublished draft whose input type has no field for a stamp, scan, completion or reward; the store reads the legacy tables with select only and writes hunts and one draft hunt_versions row. readOldGrants lists a member's own rewards from earlier editions and from the imported legacy hunt, read where they were written. Tests: lib/hunts/editions.test.ts, edition-store.test.ts, app/(main)/hunts/edition-actions.test.ts, and supabase/tests/hunt_editions.test.sql (11 assertions, run green against a local Postgres 16, not yet in CI against the real schema). Requires FH-030 and FH-033 are still open and nothing here waits on them. Not built, and moved to FH-044S: the release and import screens, the editor's publish button calling the release, the player surfaces for a run record and old grants, and letting an in-flight run finish on its old edition (today it becomes a record and takes no new credit).
